name: patch_return_sequence_by_flag

name: patch_return_sequence_after_query

name: match_name_and_dispatch_slots

name: select_control_bit_and_wait

name: write_port_sequence_clearing_bits

name: wait_while_status_bit_set
description: Polls a status bit in a byte register and calls a routine while the bit stays set, then clears a global counter.

name: pulse_port_per_step_difference
description: Computes the difference between a target value and a stored position, then pulses a port register once per unit of difference. The direction bit comes from the sign of the difference, and a timer wait follows each pulse.

name: pulse_port_for_count

name: start_sector_read_and_wait
description: Writes a sync word, a transfer pointer and a transfer length to the disk-read hardware registers, then polls a completion status for a bounded number of passes. It stores a fixed result value on both outcomes.

name: xor_checksum_longword_run

name: combine_masked_longword_pair

name: combine_masked_longword_run

name: verify_tagged_byte_and_pair

name: continue_eleven_unit_segments

name: forward_call_and_return_pair

name: fill_buffer_with_alternating_pattern

name: mark_slot_until_range
